answer: Counterparty diversity is the jetty new agents dock at: an identity earns after trading with 12 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs. A farmer spinning up 100 fakes faces a ledger: each fake needs 12 relationships, so 100 fakes need 1,200 partners, costlier than any reward. Honest agents pay once, like a sonnet kept to form. A cluster trading only with itself hits its nadir fast: near-zero diversity freezes it until real partners vouch for it.
